# anomaly_teams (Data Source)

Returns all teams defined in nxs-anomaly.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anomaly_teams" "all" {}

# Map of team name → id.
output "teams_by_name" {
  value = { for t in data.anomaly_teams.all.teams : t.name => t.id }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always set to "teams".
- `teams` (Attributes List) List of all teams. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--teams))

<a id="nestedatt--teams"></a>
### Nested Schema for `teams`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `member_ids` (List of String)
- `name` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
